name: TryAMM Asia-Pacific + China Regional Layer
purpose: Country-aware commerce, payments, sourcing, tax, logistics and compliance routing for Japan, broader Asia-Pacific and a separately governed mainland China pathway.

asiaPacific.rule: Route by country, currency, merchant capability and provider eligibility rather than treating Asia as one market.

payments: approved Alipay/WeChat Pay capable providers where lawful and available

activationRule: Architecture may exist before regional launch, but live activation is gated by provider capability, legal/compliance review, tax/privacy requirements and end-to-end testing.
